Bulk reorders all the rules in a policy set. Execute this API only once to reorder the rules
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/policySet/:policySetId/reorder

Bulk reorders all the rules in a policy set. Execute this API only once to reorder the rules

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

policySetId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the policy set.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Default value: 0
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY ARRAYREQUIRED
Array [
int64
]
Responses
​

400
401
403
404

409
415
